target: Compare two plausible methods for game learning using a novel-game rules and strategy notebook. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Compare game learning — human review
competency.outcome: Compare two plausible methods for game learning using a novel-game rules and strategy notebook. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.artifact: a novel-game rules and strategy notebook
topic_kernel.measure: learning speed and win rate on unseen levels
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: using hidden level scripts as training data

competency.practice_task: Produce a paired comparison and tradeoff table grounded in a novel-game rules and strategy notebook.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a paired comparison and tradeoff table
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report learning speed and win rate on unseen levels with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: using hidden level scripts as training data.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of game learning.
Practice: same inputs and budgets yield a justified choice.
Measurement: report learning speed and win rate on unseen levels against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for using hidden level scripts as training data; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
